First-time macOS setup: macOS will ask you to allow control of Microsoft Word / Excel / PowerPoint, and access to the folder you are saving into. Click Allow or OK on each - Canvas Downloader uses them only to convert Office files to PDF on your own Mac, and nothing is sent anywhere. One more dialog, for System Events, appears when the run finishes: that one lets the app close the Office windows it opened. All of these are one-time - except on macOS 15 and later, where “access data from other apps” returns once per session unless you grant Full Disk Access.
